title: Pure Mikanko
summary: Pure Mikanko Equip-Ritual reflection OTK and control build, supported by modern legacy support and generic staples. All core Mikanko monsters have 0 ATK, take no battle damage, and reflect all battle damage back to the opponent, transforming equipped weapons and opponent monsters into lethal damage and disruption.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ohime the Manifested Mikanko reveals itself in the hand to add any Mikanko card from Deck to hand, then discards a card.
Mikanko Water Arabesque equips to a monster on either side of the field, bounces that monster to the hand to Special Summon a Mikanko monster from the Deck, and equips itself to the summoned monster.
Mikanko Shinbu - Noble Twins sends a Mikanko card from Deck to the GY and Sets a Mikanko Spell/Trap directly from the Deck; from the GY, it can Special Summon a Mikanko Ritual Monster.
Sanaki the Mikanko Devotee bounces a Mikanko card you control to Special Summon itself; while equipped, it Special Summons a Mikanko monster from the Deck, and equips itself from the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Ohime the Manifested Mikanko + Discard
steps: Activate Ohime the Manifested Mikanko in hand, revealing herself to search Mikanko Water Arabesque from your Deck, then discard a card.
Normal Summon Ha-Re the Sword Mikanko (or equip Water Arabesque directly to an opponent's monster).
Activate Mikanko Water Arabesque to bounce the equipped monster to the hand and Special Summon Hu-Li the Jewel Mikanko from your Deck, equipping Arabesque to her.
Hu-Li triggers on being equipped to search Mikanko Promise or Mikanko Rivalry from your Deck.
With Hu-Li equipped with an Equip Card, all Mikanko cards you control become completely untargetable by opponent card effects while battle damage is reflected back to them.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ohime the Manifested Mikanko cannot be destroyed by battle, reflects all battle damage, and targets an Equip Spell in your GY as a Quick Effect on either turn to equip it to an appropriate monster on the field.
Uzuhime the Manifested Mikanko is a Rank 3 Mikanko Xyz Monster that searches an Equip Spell upon summon and can attack again.
Hu-Li the Jewel Mikanko prevents your opponent from targeting any Mikanko card you control with card effects while equipped with an Equip Card.
Ni-Ni the Mirror Mikanko can take control of an opponent's face-up monster during their turn while equipped with an Equip Card.
Arahime the Manifested Mikanko equips itself from your hand or GY to a face-up monster on the field, and returns to hand while bouncing the equipped monster during the End Phase.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mikanko Water Arabesque acts as non-destruction monster removal against the opponent while immediately Special Summoning from your Deck.
Mikanko Reflection Rondo equips to an opponent's monster to take control of it while you control a Mikanko monster.
Mikanko Spiritwalk equips an opponent's face-up monster to a Mikanko monster you control, removing threats without destruction.
Mikanko Rivalry equips an appropriate Equip Spell from your Deck to a monster on the field as a Quick-Play Trap.
Mikanko Promise Special Summons a Mikanko monster from your hand or Deck and equips it with an appropriate Equip Spell.
Heavenly Gate of the Mikanko forces the opponent to attack your equipped Mikanko monsters and grants an additional attack on monsters.
